m1-composer.title: build_weekend_state.py: compose WeekendStateRecord rows from a fitted WeekendStateModel's transform() output
m1-composer.imperative: Write tests/unit/physics/feature_view/test_build_weekend_state.py FIRST: build a small synthetic frame mirroring tests/unit/physics/weekend_state/test_model.py's make_frame(seed=626, years=(2022,2023), n_rounds=12, n_con=8) with AXES=['drag_area_closed_m2','max_power_w','brake_decel_ms2'], fit a WeekendStateModel(axes=AXES) on a train split and transform() a held-out slice, then call build_weekend_state_records(model, transformed_df, model_version=...) and assert: (1) one WeekendStateRecord per input row; (2) a row with a real (non-NaN) {axis}_car_signal + sigma is marked axis_status[axis]=='resolved' with axis_sigma[axis] passed through UNCHANGED from the car_signal sigma; (3) a row where one axis's car_signal is forced NaN (e.g. by monkeypatching/dropping that car-season from the pool, or directly constructing a transformed_df row with NaN in that column) is marked axis_status[axis]=='unresolved' with axis_sigma[axis] widened via estimate_store_fields.effective_axis_sigma (strictly >= the unresolved sentinel fraction of the value, or a reference-value-based widening when the value itself is also NaN); (4) every produced record writes successfully into a FeatureViewStore(tmp_path db).insert_weekend_state without raising. Observe the test fail (module does not exist yet) -- attest c1. Then implement src/physics/feature_view/build_weekend_state.py: a build_weekend_state_records(model, transformed_df, *, model_version) -> list[WeekendStateRecord] function that enumerates axes via BOTH model.model_cols() and model.layer_sigma_cols() (do not hand-guess column names), builds axis_values/axis_sigma/axis_status per row with the resolved/unresolved rule stated above (a NEW convention this gate introduces -- document it explicitly in the module docstring per the handoff's Note on round_idx and the Protected Intent: never fabricate, never silently drop), and documents why round_idx is omitted from the stored record's natural key (gp_name already disambiguates within a year for session_type='Q'). No src.evo_predictor import anywhere in the new file. Iterate until test_build_weekend_state.py is green -- command-check c2.
